record.question: Which one of the following statements is not accurate about Court Cases?
options: The Engineer-in-Charge of the Division concerned are primarily responsible for handling and defending court cases.
It is the primary responsibility of the departmental counsel to see to the proper defence of the case.
All defence statements to be filed by the Engineer-in-Charge are approved by the Director General and the counsel before the statement is filed.
Engineer-in-Charge updates all the court cases in Legal Information Management and Briefing System (LIMBS) regularly and ensures all information is up-to-date.
record.explanation: Defence statements are not all approved by the Director General.
